description: Use this when the user wants the register facts of one company that search_companies returned: call it with that result's id. It returns legal form, UID (Switzerland) or Firmenbuch number (Austria), seat, status, founding or registration date and trade. For legal persons it adds the registered purpose, and for Swiss legal persons the capital and former names. For listings maintained by the owner it also returns the owner's short description, website and public phone number. An average star rating with the number of reviews is included when the company has reviews. When the registers list the company, it also gives the LEI, the latest register entries of a legal person (SHAB publications in Switzerland, Firmenbuch entries in Austria), supervision by FINMA, a SECO licence for staff leasing or placement, and a Swissmedic registration for medical devices; a register that does not list the company is not mentioned, and its absence says nothing. Do not guess an id: get it from search_companies first.

id.description: The id of a result from search_companies, e.g. "ch:CHE123456789", "at:123456a" or "l:firmen-slug".
